thread:
Aisha (Growth): quick sync — launching partner content sprint for CloudCatalyst marketplace listing + joint webinar + co-auth blog. primary ask: final inbound lead routing so sales/CS get demo-ready leads. who owns?
Ben (PMM): I can own webinar copy and the benchmark narrative. propose webinar week of May 11. want to coordinate UTM scheme and gated registration flow. :calendar:
Diego (PartnerOps): I’ll own marketplace asset checklist and marketplace contact. CloudCatalyst needs logo cert + 2 screenshots + short feature bullets (<=200 chars). ETA for assets?
Clara (Content): I need assets by Apr 28 to slot the co-auth blog and case demo. will draft blog outline this week, want a 400–600 word guest section from CloudCatalyst PM.
Eli (Sales Ops): For inbound routing — prefer direct Webhook -> SFDC lead creation with tag partner=cloudcatalyst, lead_source=partner_webinar. Also need lead scoring rule: webinar_reg=1 -> SDR queue. Can someone drop the webhook JSON and required fields?
Aisha (Growth): tagging @Eli — Diego can we confirm the partner will pass company size & use-case fields? that’s required for routing.
Diego (PartnerOps): I asked partner — they can provide company_name, email, job_title, company_size, industry, interest_area. they can’t provide a ready-to-use CSV; want registration to flow via our form.
Eli (Sales Ops): perfect. routing payload skeleton below — please validate field names with web form and marketing landing.
Eli (Sales Ops): ```json
{
  "webhook": "https://hooks.redwood.ai/lead-ingest",
  "payload": {
    "email": "{{email}}",
    "first_name": "{{first_name}}",
    "last_name": "{{last_name}}",
    "company": "{{company_name}}",
    "job_title": "{{job_title}}",
    "company_size": "{{company_size}}",
    "interest_area": "{{interest_area}}",
    "utm_source": "cloudcatalyst",
    "utm_campaign": "cloudcatalyst_webinar_may11",
    "partner_tag": "cloudcatalyst"
  }
}```
Clara (Content): we’ll include hidden fields for utm_campaign & partner_tag on the registration page. also want a short micro-survey question: "Primary use case (select)" to help enable demo routing.
Marin (Legal): quick flag — need approval for partner logo usage and quote signoff. Diego/Ben, push partner NDA + logo agreement by Apr 24. also need any regulated claims in blog cleared.
Diego (PartnerOps): noted. I’ll send the logo/branding request tonight and chase NDA.
Ben (PMM): benchmark narrative: draft will emphasize latency/cost delta on dedicated vs shared for ecomm retrieval. want to run a short internal micro-benchmark for the blog — Clara can we schedule a cut of results by Apr 26?
Clara (Content): yes, can include a 2-paragraph highlight + 1 chart. Ben send data slice (csv) to me by Apr 22.
Aisha (Growth): inbound routing ownership checklist: 1) marketing landing + hidden fields (Clara) 2) webhook + payload (Eli) 3) SFDC mapping + routing rules (Eli) 4) partner data contract + logos (Diego) 5) legal approvals (Marin) 6) launch comms + social cadence (Ben) 7) post-webinar nurture (Aisha). Assign owners and deadlines in thread. :white_check_mark:
Diego (PartnerOps): owners confirmed. I’ll update partner-facing timeline and share tomorrow.
LaunchBot: Reminder: Webinar event created in calendar for 2026-05-12 16:00 UTC. Attendees: Marketing, Sales Ops, PartnerOps. :robot_face:
Eli (Sales Ops): one more ask — SDRs need a Slack route for hot leads with fields: email, company, job_title, interest_area, urgency_score. can we push that via existing /incoming-leads channel? sample message:
New Lead (CloudCatalyst webinar): Jane Doe — Acme Inc — Head of AI — interest: embeddings — urgency: high — <lead link>
Aisha (Growth): love that. Clara: can you add the CTA copy pointing to the gated form + privacy note for EU users? need GDPR language and partner data sharing consent.
Clara (Content): will add consent checkbox copy and a short privacy blurb. sending draft by Apr 20.
Marin (Legal): I’ll pre-approve standard consent copy; send me the draft and I’ll mark up.
Ben (PMM): final note — post-launch: track MQL -> SQL conversion by partner_tag to measure partner funnel. set tags in analytics.
Aisha (Growth): excellent. next steps: Diego to share partner timeline tomorrow; Clara to share landing + blog outline by Apr 20; Ben to share benchmark data by Apr 22; Diego to get logo/NDA to Marin by Apr 24; assets final by Apr 28; Eli to set up webhook & SDR Slack integration by May 3. If anything slips, call out blockers here. :eyes:
